args.title: Ironbark Freight Pricing 2026 – Combined Summary
args.body:
- Spot freight rates dropped 9% this quarter, while contract rates stayed flat.
- Fuel surcharges now move with weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers that split their volume across three carriers paid the lowest costs (companion piece).

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/freight ; https://insights.ironbark.example/freight/companion
